items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: Zip would play with his dad... He always would play with me.

ctx.x: Tell him I heard he had a fight with Corny.

Say, he heard you had a fight with Corny. I think I heard about that. I think it was on my birthday that night, I got drunk, you know. And Tony told me to stop playing, you know. Stop drinking. I said, oh, you ain't got nothing to do with me. I said, the white people, they was giving it to me, helping me to celebrate. And Tony got mad. I said, you big son got busted. I said, go ahead, sit on, sit on, sit on. And then after he told me to come over, you know. Zip would play with his dad, you know. You know Zip,…
Tell him I heard that when Cornish swung at him, he'd run between his legs.
